scenarios.title: Setup message visibility when API is ready
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the setup configuration message is shown only when apiReady state is true, reflecting the changed condition in rendering.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.

scenarios.title: Setup message absence when API is false or null
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the setup message is not shown when apiReady is false or null, as the condition was changed from apiReady === false to apiReady === true.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
